query:
insert or ignore into LeafTestRuns (
                collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            )
            select collect_nr, product_id, name, utc_date
            from TestRuns
            where collect_nr = $1

            except

            select collect_nr, product_id, parent_name, parent_date
            from TestRunHierarchies
            where collect_nr = $1
